svg.title: The real key never enters the session
svg.desc: Step one: an agent session sends a request with a placeholder. Step two: outside the session, OtoDock swaps the placeholder for the real key. Step three: the request reaches the service with the real key. The real key never enters the session. It is saved encrypted on your server, and a machine keeps it in memory only.

g.data-label: A machine keeps it in memory only.
Only the one the tool is for,
The real key never enters the session.
SSH goes further. OtoDock signs each login, and the private key never leaves the server.
